name: chase_melee
about: Chase: a hostile melee Troika human (a baseball bat, no firearm) with the player in sight ~983 cm away. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea, CNPC_VHumanCombatant's weapon split (0x103872d0: the active weapon's word & 0x18000) takes slot 604 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40 (shape.md). Slot 599 0x102b5650 admits melee (the can-enter timer past, no ranged weapon, height diff <= 64, the attack coordinator granting) and sets m_bInMelee; the in-melee tail with the player far (TOO_FAR_FOR_MELEE 0x09: d > 256, slot 555 0x1026d9a0) reaches 0x102a11d0 -> 0xe0 SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_CIRCLE_ADVANCE, or the last pair 0xca SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE (distance not below the melee range). sched_troika_melee_advance.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE MELEE_IDLE, SET_SPECIAL_DISTANCE_ACCUM DIST:COMBATMOVE, ADD_SPECIAL_DISTANCE_ACCUM_RND -64, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE DIST:ACCUM, TASK_GET_PATH_TO_ENEMY, SET_INTERRUPT_TIME 2, ADD_RANDOM_INTERRUPT_TIME 1, RUN_PATH, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT; interrupts include CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 and INTERRUPT_TIME, so the approach is re-selected every 2-3 s until the player is inside melee range (slot 555: d <= 64, dot >= 0.7 -> CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 0x51) and the tail answers 0xdc SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1. The spine: a path goal toward the player, the NPC arriving inside melee range, MELEE_ATTACK1 selected.
known_red: new: slot 599's attack-coordinator admission 0x1025db70 is a seam answering false (ElysiumNpcTroikaHelpers.cpp:142-146), so no NPC enters melee: SCHED_TROIKA_WAIT_FOR_MELEE_ADVANCE 0xe7 where retail admits a lone NPC (0x1025db70 adds it to the coordinator's list and answers true) and advances
